title: BlackRock Expands Global Bitcoin Strategy with Australian ETF Launch
summary: Bitcoin MagazineBlackRock Expands Global Bitcoin Strategy with Australian ETF LaunchAustralia will soon gain access to BlackRock’s iShares Bitcoin ETF (IBIT) on the ASX, providing regulated, local exposure to Bitcoin through a traditional exchange.This postBlackRock Expands Global Bitcoin Strategy with Australian ETF Launchfirst appeared onBitcoin Magazineand is written byMicah Zimmerman.
